verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Nitro page listing 'HD video streaming' as a perk, which implies Discord has a base video-streaming capability that Nitro upgrades. Nothing explicitly documents sharing your screen inside a voice call or using it for live collaboration. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on screen sharing during calls, details on how it works and on which platforms, base-tier versus Nitro limits, any collaboration-specific features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can share my screen during a call for live collaboration
